notes: As with all other ATTACK heroes, the goal is to push the two main damage multipliers to a high amount. Even though he may not be a main damage dealer, the output can still be decent. Assassin Set can be used as the opposite. Due to his low Shock chance, you can also raise it with this build to land Shock more easily for better enemy disruption, particularly against the main damage dealer on their team.

Playing a key role as a Sub DPS, her ATK% has to be highest/ second highest on the team. Crit Rate & Crit DMG are the main stats to focus on, with Weakness Hit aimed to be around 46%. Execution comes in handy against certain enemies (for Guild War) since it is easier to ensure she wouldn't be aiming into an Immortal/Indomitable enemy. If she is required just for her Passive and to get DEF Reduction off, survivability is priority so investing in high Block Rate is probably best considering how frail she is.
Allows them to do considerable DMG, especially necessary to have successful Chain Attacks on their S1.
Preferred in Guild War where you know Crits are going to be blocked. This build will maintain her DMG output. Aim for 77 Speed to achieve maximum ATK Boost from passive.
This build aims to let his S1 (ST Skill) hit hard on bosses.

Heal scales off ATK% so having high ATK% has the potential to full-heal the entire team to turn the tide of the battle. Accessory may not be 5* even. This aims to allow Petrification to happen at a higher rate, immobilizing the enemies when it is most necessary. Also, petrification DMG scales off ATK%.
Focuses primarily on Crit Rate (make 100%) & Crit DMG to allow consistent DMG. If he misses Crits, the entire DMG output suffers and farming may fail. Weakess Hit is a bonus stat to boost DMG.

Has passive Crit Rate Boost (27%) amd at T4 (18%) so aim for 55% Crit Rate from gears and the rest should be focused on Crit DMG & Weakness Hit. A potential build if used against Bosses, particularly Castle Rush Spike, for players who have no built out other PVE damage dealers.
This build is suitable for both PVP and PVE, focusing on both key DMG multipliers i.e. Crit Rate & Weakness Hit. As he does more DMG when Weakness Hits happen, it is important to get it high.
Has passive Weakness Hit Rate Boost (39%) & at T4 (20%), allowing focus to placed on Crit Rate & Crit DMG, allowing her to become an impactful damage dealer.
Main damage dealer oriented build. Weapon main stat can have a few options depending on how well the offensive substats are rolled. If Crit Rate is lacking, make sure to prioritize it first.

At T6, has 100% Crit Rate on skills so focus will be on mximizing Crit DMG & Weakness Hit. (Prior to T6, make sure to have Crit Rate as priority). Effect Resist has growing importance to resist Duration Reduction.
Has passive Effect Hit Rate boost (up to 49%) so focus on ATK% as her barriers scale off ATK%, allowing herself and the team to survive longer.

Has passive Crit Rate boost (33%) & at T4 (18%) so will need 49% Crit Rate from gears with the rest focusing on Crit DMG. Often tend to be used with Biscuit so Weakness Hit should range from 20% (w/ Rachel) to 46% (w/o Rachel). Against Leonid who has very high DEF, DEF Ignoring from this build comes in very essential to be able to defeat the boss as soon as possible. As 100% Crit Rate is easier to achieve, focus on Crit DMG and 46% Weakness Hit. An extremely endgame build that required a Legendary combination Ring to get him to survive as long as possible to be able to nuke the boss down without additional support. Crit DMG is priotized over Weakness Hit.
Focus on Crit Rate & Weakness Hit for consistent DMG output even on Follow-Up attacks.

Although reliant on Bleed, Crit Rate & Crit DMG are still important multipliers for dealing pure DMG to bosses. Although ATK% allows for more (but not significantly more) Bleed DMG, overall the results lead to slower runs if Crits do not happen.

While not the main damage dealer, this build helps to allow DMG against bosses to stilll be above average. Focus on Crit Rate & Crit DMG. Make sure his ATK is not higher than the actual DPSs. If bulk is lacking, this build can be used instead. Afterall, it is more important for him to survive for his immunity and Crit DMG Boost.

Standard damage dealer build. Has passive Crit Rate boost (41%) & at T4 (18%), so aim for 41% Crit Rate from gears and 20-46% Weakness Hit. If substat rolls for Crit Rate, can opt for double Crit DMG weapons.
Standard damage dealer build. Without innate self-boosts, he will need 82% Crit Rate from here and 46% Weakness Hit. If substat rolls for Crit Rate, can opt for double Crit DMG weapon main stats.
Main priority would be to boost all 3 offensive multipliers to turn her into somewhat of a damage dealer to allow her to get her Chain Attacks off and continuously lower allies' Skill Cooldown (T6).
Barrier & heals scale off Max HP so the build goes for a mixture of Effect Hit & HP%. If Effect Hit is decently high (considering Pets & allies), HP% should be the go-to weapon main stat.

This build aims to not only let her heal more, but also increase Max HP due to her innate bulk so there for her to outlast the enemy and win by HP. For those without good Paladin pieces, the standard Gatekeeper build is something to fall back on to give her 100% Block Rate more easily with DMG Taken Reduction.

Standard build to boost tankiness via Block Rate and also DGM Taken Reduction. S2 provides CC Immunity at T6 so having Turn 1 CC Immunity almost guarantees that it will be casted without any hindrance from the enemy.
Main DMG multipliers have DEF scaling. Main role is also to stun enemies effectively so having some Effect Hit substats would be good.

This build aims to increase the chance of landing Death while also having decent bulk for him to serve his Tank purposes. If Effect Hit is sufficient, HP% can be considered as his healing scales off HP%.

Barrier and attacks scale with HP so it's best to maximize his Max HP, which also ensuring tankiness with DMG Taken Reduction with good Block Rate rolls. With a passive Block Rate (23%), aim for 77% more Block Rate, along with DMG Taken Reduction to boost his tankiness as best as possible.
Aim for high Crit Rate & Weakness Hit to maximise DMG output. Viable for both PVP and PVE. If used in PVE, can also use Assassin Set with the same priority on substats.
CC accessories can proc during follow-up attacks. Spellweaver for increased Effect Probability. Can opt for more Defensive Main Stats if allies give Effect Hit.
Some Effect Resistance to resist Death and CC. Some Effect Hit to inflict Crystals debuffs. Aim for high Block Rate with DMG Taken Reduction for the best results.

As Crit may be resisted by Block, Weakness Hit gives her more consistent damage so that her S2 can nuke right after the HP alteration. Aim for high Crit Rate & Weakness Hit, both near 100%. Has SPD-Based ATK Boost (up to 1320 with 77 Speed). Sufficient Weakness Hit Chance also needed to help her target lower HP enemies, enabling her Chain Attack. This build makes her take on the debuffer role where to land Paralysis on enemies, so that their Block Rate becomes 0% and allies can then nuke much easier.

Has passive Crit Rate Boost (33%) & at T4 (18%), requiring just 51% Crit Rate from gears and allies that provide Active Crit Rate Boost. More focus on building Crit DMG and Weakness Hit Chance. With a powerful 3-Target Skill, capitalize on getting her Crit Rate & Weakness Hit multipliers high to be able to deal with even Tank teams.
Magic Reflux DMG scales with ATK. Reliant on Blessing to tank DMG instead of defensive stats . Spellweaver Effect Probability for increased Stun and Magic Reflux chances.

Effect Resist helps keep her Immortality on against Buff Removals and Buff Duration Reductions. T6 grants 100% Crit Rate to her skills, so prioritize building for Weakness Hit Chance and Crit DMG. If non-T6, can also have substats in Crit Rate but less recommended.
One of her skills deal extra DMG if it lands as a weakness hit so high weakness hit chance is highly desirable

Primarily a PVP hero so aim to have high Crit Rate & Weakness Hit so as to kill better to activate his Chain Attack. Primarily a PVP hero so aim to have high Crit Rate & Weakness Hit so as to kill better to activate his Chain Attack.
Speed mule for Magic teams in Guild War. Win speed contest to increase all enemies Skill Cooldown.

Aim for high Crit Rate & Crit DMG to hit hard on both Basic Attacks and skills. More for PVE purposes. Aim for high Crit Rate & Crit DMG to hit hard on both Basic Attacks and skills. More for PVP purposes. Immortal ring is most recommended due to her fragility.

It is very important to land Crits on the Ox King minions to kill them properly so focus primarily on Crit Rate & Crit DMG. Transition towards Avenger Set, focusing on Crit Rate and Crit DMG (especially after Daisy is T6) to allow her to become a ST damage dealer.

Has passive Crit Rate Boost (40%) before T4 so make up the rest of the 60% with the Assassin Set & Crit Rate rolls. Has passive Crit Rate Boost (40%) & at T4 (18%), allowing for priority in building for Crit DMG and Weakness Hit Chance. Will still need 42% Crit Rate from gears.

Before T4, Weakness Hit could be lacking so it may be necessary to have Weakness Hit main stats on the weapons. Has passive Weakness Hit Chance Boost (39%) & at T4 (20%) and often used with Biscuit, allowing for heavier priority in building for Crit Rate and Crit DMG.
Prioritize survivability to ensure her basic attack's effect can be casted continuously. Aim is to increase Burn DMG on the boss.

Has Passive Weakness Hit Chance Boost (T2; 39%) & at T4 (20%) and often paired with Biscuit, allowing for priority in building for Crit Rate and Crit DMG. Focus only on Crit Rate to be 100% and Weakness Hit to be 60%. ATK at 4.3K. Crit DMG is secondary importance.
Has passive Effect Hit Rate Boost (34%), allowing for priority in building for also having some bulk for survivability.
Longer duration Immortality helps SJW build Level Up stacks better than Guts. An option for PVE especially when farming and high Crit Rate allows consistently high damage.
Recommended for Death teams so that Death has a better chance to be inflicted. Alternatively, for Death teams, Gatekeeper set with Speed rolls also work (main stats see right).
Usually enough for survivability. Choice of Armor main stat will depend on how much Block Rate on substats. Speed is situational but can be the Most important stat for efficient PVE runs.
Attacks, heals and barrier provision are all HP%-scaling so this build fully maximizes her HP so that she gives MAGIC allies better survivability.

Attacks also scale off DEF so DEF% is the preferred main stat. He is usually used in the frontline, best to get his Block Rate as high as possible while using DMG Taken Reduction armors. Paladin set so that the Incoming Healing Boost increases his recovery to a large extent. However, this will require way better substat rolls for Block Rate.

Heals based off her HP% so this build maximizes her healing capabiltiies. As she is mostly used in PVE, Block Rate % is less important but in PVP, Block Rate should be 100% with Revive. May opt for Gatekeeper set in PVP.
Has DEF-Based Block Rate Boost so will need at least 1350/1650 DEF to get up to 27%/33% Block Rate.
Very important to keep him alive for this passive to be retained. So making him bulky is the most important priority, with as much Block Rate rolls as possible to complement DMG Taken Reduction.

Goal is to land Shock with higher probability since her innate Effect Probability is considerably low. May opt for ATK% main stats as Shock scales off caster's ATK. If using her, then having her around is the biggest asset your team can have to upkeep their DMG output. Thus, keeping her alive as long as possible is the most important priority.

Being able to cleanse debuffs with any skill would mean starting the battle with guaranteed CC immunity equates to a guaranteed cleanse for your heroes. This build aims to make her more bulky so that her core effects can last on the field longer.
This build increases Burn DMG dealt to the Bosses.
His heal is based off DMG dealt so it is important to boost his DMG and traditionally this was done by raising Crit Rate & Crit DMG. Has passive Block Rate of 33%.

Being a Death hero, the goal is the have the highest possible chance to land Death. Defensive armor main stats are used to prolong his existence on the field, given that he does have innate Immortality. Healing scales of ATK% so having a max ATK% build for PVE can continuously sustain your team.

A must-use to increase chance of Fear and Death. ATK% may also be needed to allow Mist to have higher ATK to be able to inflict Death instantly after Fear. Has passive 34% Effect Hit Rate. Despite being a universal hero, she is not very tanky and so this build seeks to sustain her better so as to give her more time to land her debuffs for field control. Having high ATK% allows Mist to have higher likelihood of inflicting Unremovable Death after Fear with just her Skill 2. However, this causes her to be more fragile and Death is still not guaranteed.
As she gets 100% Weakness Hit at T6, focus substats and gears on Crit Rate & Crit DMG. This maximizes her DMG output as she also gains PATK%. Before T6, include Weakness Hit rolls too.

Due to usage in various score-related Boss battles, this build helps to achieve that. If she's too frail, Guts Accessory and DMG Taken Reduction armors can be considered. Make sure ATK is not higher than main DPS and Crit Rate & Crit DMG are the main focus. This build is an option if you find survivability an issue, especially in the early game where she isn't actually a SubDPS either. May need Speed to allow DPS to go last.
Has Max HP-Based ATK Boost so this build aims to make it easier to get 9000-11000 HP to get 1080/1320 additional ATK. Furthermore, skills also have HP scaling.
At T6, gets 100% Crit Rate, allowing focus to be placed on Weakness Hit & Crit DMG. Sometimes, Crit DMG may be less of a focus and tankiness is prioritized instead. Can use this for non-Boss PVE too.

At T6, focus purely on near 100% Weakness Hit & high Crit DMG. Also, aim for 40% Block Rate from gears (passive Block Rate 60%). Before getting 100% Crit Rate at T6, Crit Rate is still an important stat to have on her for DMG so using this build allows you to achieve a high Crit Rate with relative ease. Not a common build but this aims to increase her Barrier amount and self-heal as well to sustain herself for much longer since her Pain Endurance acts as a DMG Cap already.

This is the ideal damage dealer build to maximize DMG output. There may be times where Guts/Immortal Rings are needed as his heal may not be sufficient and his bulk isn't enough.

Giving her this build increases the chip damage. If she doesn't survive well, give her DMG Taken Reduction instead of ATK%. Weakness Hit main stat for CR. ATK% main stat for Dungeon.
